- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations for younger readers (4-6 years old):
  1. "The Big Book of Dinosaurs" by Yuval Zommer
  2. "Dinosaur Roar!" by Paul Stickland
  3. "Oh, Say Can You Say Di-no-saur?" by Bonnie Worth
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations for early readers (7-9 years old):
  1. "National Geographic Kids Dinopedia"
  2. "Dinosaurs" by Gail Gibbons
  3. "The Magic School Bus Inside a Dinosaur" by Joanna Cole and Bruce Degen
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations for older readers (10-12 years old):
  1. "Dinosaur Odyssey: Fossil Threads in the Web of Life" by Scott D. Sampson
  2. "The Dinosaur Hunters" by Deborah Cadbury
  3. "Dinosaurs: The Most Complete, Up-to-Date Encyclopedia for Dinosaurs" by Thomas R. Holtz Jr.
